title: Full-Stack AI Application Development
description: A comprehensive hands-on curriculum to build modern AI-powered web applications from scratch.

lessons.title: Day 1: TypeScript 5.8 & Advanced Type Systems
lessons.description: Master discriminated unions, type narrowing, and strict module resolution.

lessons.title: Day 2: React 19 Actions & Optimistic State
lessons.description: Implement form actions, useOptimistic, and high-performance re-rendering patterns.

lessons.title: Day 3: Embeddings & Vector Similarity Search
lessons.description: Understand high-dimensional vector spaces, cosine distance, and in-memory indexing.

lessons.title: Day 4: LLM Function Calling & Tool Orchestration
lessons.description: Build an autonomous agent with schema-based tools and structured JSON responses.

lessons.title: Day 5: Capstone Project Deployment & Offline Sync
lessons.description: Package the application into an Android mobile APK with offline-first persistence.
